Check graph validity, statement quality, and binding coverage. Give a statement to check that text with the project dictionary before a write.

Usage: provenance check [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --quiet                          Drop the advisory notes commands print alongside their output, such as the warning that this repository has no shaping skills installed
      --repo <REPO>                    [default: .]
      --strict                         Reject findings in statements committed at Git HEAD, and every bindings finding
      --base <BASE>                    Compare Git HEAD with this commit instead of its first parent
      --statement <STATEMENT>          Check this statement instead of the committed statements
      --graph                          Run only graph validity checks. Combine with other check selectors
      --statements                     Run only statement quality checks. Combine with other check selectors
      --bindings                       Run only Rule binding checks. The scan covers the repository root; --path limits it
      --gaps                           Run only the gaps check: report the unfinished parts of the graph and each Rule without a Source. These findings do not fail the check
      --docs                           Run only the docs check: report each Markdown link that names a page the docs site does not publish
      --scope <SCOPE>                  Check only this scope. The default is every declared scope
      --path <PATH>                    Bindings check only: scan the files below this path. The default is the repository root
      --baseline <BASELINE>            Bindings check only: resolve evidence anchors against this earlier scan report. Needs --scope
      --output <OUTPUT>                Bindings check only: write the scan report of the selected scope to this file. Needs --scope
      --output-format <OUTPUT_FORMAT>  [possible values: json, markdown]
      --format <FORMAT>                [possible values: json]
  -h, --help                           Print help
